label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1, in the final trials of the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the agent chose a2 and reached S1 (a rare transition): 100% of activations on dev. It fires only in episode trials 90-99, where the value head output is lowest (all activations fall in the bottom value bin). The value head output drops as the episode nears its end. Thresholding value < 2.5 gives dev F1 0.76 (P 0.63, R 0.95, mass recall 0.97). ep_trial >= 95 in place of value gives F1 0.38. Adding prev_reward == 1 raises F1 only slightly (0.78) and lowers mass recall (0.85), so the simpler predicate is recorded. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, on common a2->S2 transitions, or before trial 90. The strongest activations come at the very last trials of an episode (often the rel +1 trial of windows that end the episode), but I did not check this magnitude ordering systematically. All variables are observed at D2: the choice and the reached state are shown, and value is the output of the agent value head. No future variables are used.
